## Intent
Hypothesis: Halide-expressible branchless blend over AoS particles can approach the streaming ceiling by eliminating branch divergence in the death/respawn decision.

## Layout & approach
The 68 B/p AoS layout offers 32 hot bytes (47%) for loop 1 and 28 (41%) for loop 2 — over half each line is dead weight. No intermediate storage keeps the death verdict in registers, fusing integrate+decide+respawn+render into one stride-68B pass. The cmov-based select approach should avoid misprediction but inflates instruction count; with 47% hot bytes the effective working set is smaller than raw 68·N.

## Cache saturation
Cost is flat: ~20.3 ns/p in L1d (N=320), ~20.0 in L2 (N=3100), ~19.3 in L3 (N=99000), ~21.4 in DRAM (N=620000). No knee at L1d (N≈481), L2 (N≈7710), or L3 (N≈246723) spills — under 12% variation across four orders of magnitude in N. This flatness signals frontend-bound execution: cache capacity is irrelevant when instruction delivery is the bottleneck.

## Bandwidth
Achieved 2.5-3.5 GB/s against the 12.69 GB/s ceiling — 20-28% of capacity. The 5.359 ns/p memory floor frames irreducible memory time; at ~20 ns/p the algo sits 3.7x above floor. Profile confirms: 46-53% frontend_stall, 0% backend_stall, 0% branch_flush across all N and q. Death rate is the real axis: q=0.01 achieves 3.35 GB/s (N=320) vs 2.68 at q=0.5 — the cmov chain lengthens with respawn frequency. The algo holds 0.74-0.92x baseline but trails the winner 1.4-2.7x, widest at low q where the winner's autovectorization advantage is largest.

## Assembly
Codegen is scalar for particle physics despite the Halide label: vmovss, vmulss, vaddss, vsubss are all scalar-qualified — no packed FP SIMD. The loop digest shows ~160 insns/iter, 13 conditional branches, 12 cmov selects, and 19 byte-granular stores per particle. vpaddusb appears for pixel-buffer saturation but not for integration. The death decision uses setge/setns/or/test/jne (0x107a1e6-0x107a211) rather than true blends. The render scatter writes individual RGBA bytes via movzx+add+cmovb+mov BYTE PTR (0x107a26b-0x107a2b7). The 160-instruction body explains the 46-53% frontend_stall.

## Verdict
Refuted — the branchless blend never materializes in codegen. The algo beats naive scalar by 8-26% (0.74-0.92x baseline) but trails the winner 1.4-2.7x everywhere. At q=0.01, N=320 it is 2.735x slower than the winner; at q=0.5 it narrows to 1.511x — the winner's autovectorization advantage shrinks with death rate but never vanishes. The mechanism: scalar FP with no packed SIMD, 13 branches and 12 cmovs per iteration, and 19 byte-granular stores produce a 160-instruction body stalling the frontend at 46-53%, achieving 20-28% of ceiling with zero cache-regime sensitivity.
